Age for screening: 24.5 – 64 years

Screening of immunocompromised Pts:

•HIV positive => Annually.
•End stage renal disease= @ diagnosis.
•Transplant = within 1 year.
•Cytotoxic drugs = @ start of treatment.
•Renal disease on dialysis + mild dyskaryosis => urgent referral for colposcopy.

Cervical screening colposcopy management recommendations:

Punch Biopsy:

•Cytology is high grade.
•Abnormal T – zone.
•High Grade colposcopy.

 

High grade

 

Treatment within 8 weeks

> 90 should be referred within 4 weeks.

Treatment:

Ablative procedure:

1.Cold coagulation under local Anaesthesia @ 1200.
2.Cryocautry – freeze under local Anaesthesia
3.Laser – vaporization under L/A.

Excisional procedure:

1.LLETZ – 7mm by Diathermy loop.
2.Laser cone under local anesthesia.
3.Knife cone – CGIN – GA.
4.Hysterectomy – 2nd line.

Hysterectomy:

⇨Biopsy + colposcopy is must before TAH.
⇨Mapping with Lugol’s iodine before surgery to identify VaiN.
